description: A non-transferable inception (empty next keys, basic non-transferable prefix), then a rotation of the same identifier, signed by its own key. No more key events are allowed after a non-transferable inception (line 340), so a validator must not accept the rotation. Built on keripy 1.x's wire: KERI 1.0 bodies with keripy 1.x's field sets and CESR 1.00 attachments, mirroring KERI-0024 (KS-31) in keri-v1.0.1.
title: keripy 1.x: rotation after a non-transferable inception
